purpose: Schema PRIOR for the dynamic-application runtime. Hints only. Fresh rendered DOM is authoritative. Nothing here is a selector contract or a script.

coverage.note: Two samples are the modern applytojob.com/apply/<key>/<slug> single-page form (fully mapped, blank, visible). Third is the legacy /apply/jobs/details/<key> 'Job Listings' variant where the identical form_submit_new_resume form is present in the DOM but hidden; the 'Apply Now' anchor click did not reveal it within 3s, so its controls were read from the hidden DOM (labels/options only).

observed_samples.page_title: Ad Operations Specialist - Smadex SLU - Career Page
observed_samples.entry: form is rendered on the job page itself under heading 'Apply for this position'

observed_samples.page_title: Digital Marketing Specialist (Remote) - NRTC - Career Page

observed_samples.entry: anchor a#resumator_btn_apply_now 'Apply Now' clicked once (read-only, opens form); form stayed display:none in the capture; controls read from hidden DOM
observed_samples.classification_note: Same backend (JazzHR 'resumator' ids, form id form_submit_new_resume, reCAPTCHA sitekey identical) but different page template; the self-hosted page embeds an iframe of its own URL.

page_shape.form: form#form_submit_new_resume method=POST action=<same page url>; hidden inputs form_id=submit_new_resume, resumator-subdomain-value, resumator-tags-value, uploaded-file, resumator-sfdc-id
page_shape.captcha_widget: Google reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox (iframes recaptcha/api2/anchor + bframe; hidden textarea#g-recaptcha-response labelled 'Human Check*')
page_shape.cookie_banner: 'This website uses cookies...' with Allow control (rp-01/02)

control_families.text: input[type=text|email|tel] id/name resumator-<field>-value; label text ends with '*' when required; required is NOT set as an attribute (required=false, no aria-required) — a sibling help/hint reads 'REQUIRED*'. maxlength seen: phone 50, address 255, city 255, state 50, postal 50.
control_families.address_group: Four inputs under one 'Address*' label: placeholders 'Address','City','State/Province','Postal' (ids resumator-address/city/state/postal-value). jz-03 labels the group 'Location'.
control_families.file: input[type=file]#resumator-resume-value (no accept attr); helper text 'Attach resume as .pdf, .doc, .docx, .odt, .txt, or .rtf (limit 5MB) or paste resume'; anchors a#resumator-choose-upload 'Attach resume' / a#resumator-choose-paste 'Paste resume' toggle a textarea#resumator-resumetext-value alternative.
control_families.native_select: select#resumator-questionnaire-q<digits> name=resumator-questionnaire[<digits>]; first option '-- No answer --' (value present, so has_value=true in a blank form).
control_families.checkbox: input[type=checkbox] id resumator-checkbox-<qid>-<n> (privacy policy acceptance, value = label text) and input#resumator-sms-consent (value 1).
control_families.submit: a#resumator-submit-resume 'Submit Application' / 'SUBMIT APPLICATION' (anchor, href='/', no role) on modern pages; input[type=button]#resumator-submit-resume plus #resumator-cancel-resume on legacy page. STOP BOUNDARY.

blockers.detail: reCAPTCHA v2 (same sitekey 6LeCbWYs... on all three employers) must be solved by a human before submit.
jz-03 form not revealed by one Apply Now click; needs human/user check or second attempt with scroll.

runtime_observations: Required-ness is conveyed only by the trailing '*' in label text and the 'REQUIRED*' hint; native required/aria-required are absent.
Custom question ids are numeric per employer (q2670621...); the stable key is the label text.
No EEO/demographic block was present in any of the three samples.

inferred.eeo_inference: JazzHR can append an EEO/OFCCP section for US employers; not observed here. Treat as possible.
inferred.legacy_reveal_inference: The legacy 'Apply Now' probably toggles the form container via JS on the same page (form action equals the page URL); may need scroll-into-view.

provider_hint.for_jev: JazzHR (applytojob.com): single-page form, ids resumator-<field>-value; required = label ends with '*' (no attributes). Custom questions are native <select> with '-- No answer --' first, text (255), or textarea narratives; classify each. Work-authorization selects can be multi-valued (citizenship/OPT/permit/sponsorship), so map from verified visa facts, never default. reCAPTCHA v2 is a human step. Stop at 'Submit Application'.
escalate_to_writer_opus: experience narrative textarea ('Do you have experience in a similar role?...')
requires_human_input: any salary/comp question the user has not pre-answered

edge_cases: Legacy /apply/jobs/details/<key> pages embed an iframe of their own URL and title 'JazzHR » Job Listings'; the form is hidden until Apply Now.
Some inventory URLs are http:// and one uses a generated subdomain (20220120194401_...applytojob.com) — same template expected, unverified.
